$comment: builtin__trigger_create payload for IronClaw 1.4.0 (execution_contract schema, verified against the binary on 2026-09-17). Deferred tools return their schema on first call — call trigger_create twice if the first reply carries a 'note' asking to call again.
name: jyotish-daily-brief

execution_contract.goal: Produce today's Jyotish-OS morning brief for the stored primary birth chart (default GOLDEN chart {"birth": {"utc": "1990-03-15T06:30:00Z", "lat": 28.6139, "lon": 77.2090, "tz_offset_hours": 5.5}} until the user stores their own). Call mcp-jyotish-local__panchang__day for today at the chart's location, mcp-jyotish-local__transit__window for today for all bodies against the natal chart, and mcp-jyotish-local__dasha__timeline (graha.vimsottari, depth 3) to find the running maha/antar/pratyantar. State every value with its evidence.consensus_status; if any nakshatra/pada/rashi has boundary_distance_sec below 120, say so explicitly.
success_criteria: panchang.day, transit.window and dasha.timeline were each called once and returned results
The brief names tithi, nakshatra with its end time, today's transits, and the running dasha periods with end dates
Any consensus_status other than PASS is stated verbatim
execution_contract.output_instructions: A short brief in sections: Panchang / Transits today / Running dasha / Cautions. No predictions of certainty; quote validation_status where a rule is cited.
execution_contract.no_result_text: No panchang or transit data could be computed today; the jyotish tools returned errors (quoted).
